svg.text: 1. Power harness - wheels + BOTH new 12 V arms
Selected battery: VOLTON 12 V 45 Ah lithium-ion. Red = battery/motion +; orange = 5 V +; black N = separate return to battery-negative bus.
S1: push to LOCK / twist to RELEASE
Small coil current only - not motor current
Use no 12 V on this box
Existing USB hub + optional second hub
U6 small 5V pin needs regulated 5 V
N = BATTERY-NEGATIVE STAR BUS: one separate black wire from every device/converter return.
E-STOP PRESSED: wheels + both arms OFF. Jetson, hubs and monitor ON. Twist-release restores motor power immediately.
Pictures show component appearance. Battery current limits, regulator model and actual terminal polarity are not inferred from appearance.
Rev B pictorial supplement | 2026-11-26 | * = provisional rating | Drawing positions do not establish terminal polarity.
Follow actual + / - / NC markings. Battery BMS, K1 continuous duty / coil / suppression and I2C pin mapping still need verification.
